items.title: 18.10.2 Reaction of Manganate(VII) Ion with Iron(II) Ion (manganate(VII) ion ka iron(II) ion se reaction) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 18.10.2, printed page 31.

blocks.text: Is redox reaction mein MnO₄⁻ reduce aur Fe²⁺ oxidize hota hai, jaisa potential values batati hain. Reduction form (shakal) mein half-reactions yeh hain:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Fe³⁺/Fe²⁺ ka E° −0.77 V chhaapti hai; sahi value +0.77 V hai, jo kitab ka apna Quick Check 18.8 bhi deta hai.

Dono equations ko mila kar balance karein aur un ke potentials se poore reaction ki feasibility check karein. Har Fe²⁺ ek electron deta hai aur MnO₄⁻ ko paanch chahiye, is liye iron wali half-equation ko 5 se multiply (zarb) karte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab overall equation MnO₄⁻ + 5Fe²⁺ → Mn²⁺ + 5Fe²⁺ + 4H₂O aur E° = +2.29 V likhti hai: is mein 8H⁺ nahi aur products mein Fe³⁺ ki jagah Fe²⁺ likha hai, aur −0.77 V ke saath sum (jor) ghalat hai. Sahi: MnO₄⁻ + 8H⁺ + 5Fe²⁺ → Mn²⁺ + 5Fe³⁺ + 4H₂O, E°cell = 1.52 − 0.77 = +0.75 V.
Standard electrode potential ki positive value batati hai ke yeh reaction daen taraf chalega, yani feasible hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek mole MnO₄⁻ ke saath kitne mole Fe²⁺ react karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Paanch: har MnO₄⁻ paanch electrons leta hai aur har Fe²⁺ ek deta hai.
